title: Eager Buyer
kidsText: Someone offers twice what you paid for a rental. Sell it, or keep the rent?
adultText: A family relocating for work offers double what you paid for any rental you own. Sell, or keep the cash flow?

title: Tenant Moves Out
kidsText: A renter moves out. Each rental you own pays $100 less a month for now.
adultText: A tenant breaks their lease. Each rental you own earns $100 less per month until you find someone new.

title: Stock Split
kidsText: Each share you own becomes two shares. Same value today.
adultText: Every stock you hold splits two for one. Twice the shares, same total value today.

title: Highway Comes Through
kidsText: The state buys your land for a new road. You get more than you paid.
adultText: The state buys any land you own for the new highway at one and a half times what you paid. You cannot refuse.

title: Market Dip
kidsText: The stock market drops. Your index funds are worth 20 percent less today.
adultText: A rough quarter. Every index fund you hold loses 20 percent of its value. The ones who stay in usually get it back.

title: Bull Run
kidsText: The market climbs. Your index funds and CDs are worth 10 percent more.
adultText: A strong year for everyone who stayed invested. Index funds and CDs gain 10 percent of their value.

title: Rents Go Up
kidsText: Rent goes up in town. Each rental you own pays you $50 more a month.
adultText: Demand outruns supply. Every rental you own earns 50 more per month at the next lease renewal.

title: Business Buyer
kidsText: Someone wants to buy one of your businesses for one and a half times what you paid.
adultText: A buyer offers 150 percent of what you paid for any one business you own. Take the cash, or keep the monthly income?

title: Developer Wants Your Land
kidsText: A builder wants your land. They offer three times what you paid!
adultText: A home builder offers three times your purchase price for any one piece of land you own. Patience can pay.

title: Recession
kidsText: Hard times. Index funds drop 30 percent, and each business earns $100 less a month.
adultText: Layoffs spread and spending slows. Index funds lose 30 percent of their value, and each business earns 100 less a month.

title: Recovery Rally
kidsText: The market comes back. Your index funds grow 15 percent today.
adultText: The rebound comes faster than anyone expected. Every index fund you hold gains 15 percent of its value.

title: Bank Loyalty Bonus
kidsText: Your bank gives savers a bonus. Savings and CDs grow 5 percent today.
adultText: Banks compete for deposits. Every savings account and CD you hold gets a bonus of 5 percent of its value.

title: Big Employer Moves In
kidsText: A big factory opens in town. Each rental and business pays $80 more a month.
adultText: A battery plant hires two thousand people. Every rental and business you own earns 80 more per month.

title: Plant Closes
kidsText: A big factory closes. Each rental and business pays $80 less a month.
adultText: The town's largest employer shuts down. Every rental and business you own earns 80 less per month.

title: Dividend Raise
kidsText: Companies share more profit. Each stock you own pays $20 more a month.
adultText: A strong year for profits. Every stock holding you own pays 20 more per month in dividends.

title: Three-for-One Split
kidsText: Each share you own turns into three shares. Same value today.
adultText: Every stock you hold splits three for one. Three times the shares at a third of the price.

title: Investor Buys Rentals
kidsText: A company wants one of your rentals. They offer one and a half times what you paid.
adultText: A rental company is buying up homes. It offers 150 percent of what you paid for any one rental. Sell, or keep the rent?

title: Flood Map Redrawn
kidsText: New maps say your land floods. You must sell it for less than you paid.
adultText: New flood maps make your land hard to build on. You must sell any land you own at 80 percent of what you paid.

title: Index Fund Correction
kidsText: The market slips. Your index funds are worth 10 percent less today.
adultText: A routine pullback. Every index fund you hold loses 10 percent of its value. Selling now locks in the loss.

title: Property Taxes Rise
kidsText: Taxes go up on buildings. Each rental pays you $40 less a month.
adultText: The county reassesses. Every rental you own earns 40 less per month after the higher tax bill.
